title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: This committee will provide a direct voice for Indian badminton players in the sport's governance, ensuring their welfare and perspectives are considered.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, a crucial step towards empowering players within the national badminton framework.

title: Junior World Championships Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: Indian junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing to represent the nation at the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India's brightest young badminton talents are currently participating in a national coaching camp in Guwahati, honing their skills for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, directly benefiting the development of future Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur, focusing on upgrading the skills of national coaches.

title: Indian Junior Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttlers are preparing at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, aiming for continental success.
summary: A dedicated coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior tournaments will impact how young Indian players develop their game and strategy from an early age.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
